# dg01: make an admissible dominant gem objective visible to the opening policy

Base commit `2f0f534e8311ee597e516b11c2afca1bbf608060`, base bot `leader_party_tuned`. Allowed candidate directory `bots/pi_dominant-gems-01/` only, including required `IMPLEMENTATION.md`. Do not inherit either item experiment.

## Evidence and hypothesis

Our current policy's choose_camp runs distance_only=true and bootstrap=true before shop_phase3. Thus it ignores reward size even when a high-value group becomes eligible. In current engine3, 00vault's central group has49 passive gem clusters, 5880 total HP and343 gems; all other groups together have16 gems. No initial member of our four-pick roster passes the existing max_clear90 estimate for the center. In ranked loss01a1a978-6393-7eab-b12e-f7804eff3be2, Vesper buys7 Strength shards at209, making estimated clear66, before enemy first central clear272/capture278; our first actors enter phase3 only625/629. This is an opportunity, not proof Vesper was free, safe or nearby enough to take it.

Direct Fish diagnostic01a1a9b5-5820-755b-8197-db4f68af6378 is a disconfirming speed benchmark: Fish clears center at33 (last hit Vendetta), Marcella captures343 at39, and wins1142–8 at262. The proposed change retains our initial exclusion and CANNOT reproduce that opening. It tests later objective valuation under the existing executor and roster. Do not claim it will beat Fish. On04restricted_area there is no dominant group; economic losses also involve enemy capture of groups we cleared. This policy does not address that mechanism.

## Exact treatment

Compute once per World initialization, using legal public static camp metadata, whether there is a group satisfying ALL:

- positive gem reward and zero gold reward;
- every member is a gem_cluster (passive type), no attacking monster member;
- its gem reward strictly exceeds the SUM of gem rewards of every other map group, including unreachable ones.

Strict dominance makes the group unique. Use 64-bit sums and canonical World camp indices after anchor sorting; never hardcode a map name, engine group ID, coordinate, or reward343. Preserve the existing World ordering and route packet mapping.

Only when choose_camp is selecting a new task AND bootstrap==true, prefer this group IF its entry in the existing eligible vector is true. Return it after the normal eligibility scan and before the ordinary bootstrap fallback. Leave every existing eligibility check and distance field unchanged, including retry, reachability, respawn and max_clear90. If absent/ineligible, return exactly the existing selected result. Non-bootstrap planner precedence must remain unchanged. No task preemption, no new travel admission threshold, no expanded clear limit or loop-phase change, no global value_routing toggle, no item/draft/combat/navigation/retreat/bank changes. Additional work should be static at initialization except a constant-time selection check. Do not add release logging.

This is a narrow test of a map-structure opportunity, not a generic farming rewrite. Prefer the smallest implementation seam that expresses the rule and can later support evidence-based valuation. Do not generalize it into a strategy framework.

## Correctness and falsification

Meaningful focused checks for strict dominance vs equality, zero reward, attacking/mixed groups, gold-bearing groups, canonical index after sorting, bootstrap vs later phase, and eligible vs blocked/cooling/respawning/too-long-clear cases. Pure metadata/selection checks are appropriate if they exercise the helper actually used; avoid duplicating implementation expressions in disconnected tests. Preserve original roster and all other source policies. Report exact checks performed and limitations; do not claim SDK integration tests if only native checks ran.

PC diagnostic first: exact-source release build on CLI5/current engine;00vault both sides versus frozen champion and C02, matching baseline. Require zero candidate VM faults. Inspect actual central camp clear/capture/bank events, not merely wins or score. If candidate never productively captures the dominant group, retain failed mechanism evidence and diagnose whether eligibility, task commitment, combat, capture access or banking prevented it. Do not broaden or upload on a proxy win alone.

If diagnostic mechanism succeeds, run the same80-game regression screen. Direct champion >=8/16 and common >=31/64 are minimal regression conditions, NOT a positive strength claim; the rare rule may not trigger there. Broader testing must include predeclared development maps, diverse opponents and no-dominant negative controls. Fresh confirmation maps remain reserved. No platform upload or ranked change from this job. PC will provide exact source/artifact identities and measure active-rule exposure, target rewards, banking/deaths/faults plus paired outcomes. Existing task_limit90 remains; report observed expiration rather than modifying it.

Leave commits/push to the bridge. Write IMPLEMENTATION.md with actual diff, checks, uncertainty and expected diagnostic limitations.
